50 years ago I was sealed by the priestess\n    Kikyo, protector of the sacred Shikon jewel.
Now I am free of the seal, and journey in\n      pursuit of my archenemy, Naraku.
Along my travels, I've met Miroku, the monk\n     with the "Wind Tunnel" on his hand,
Sango the demon slayer, the young fox demon\n     Shippo, and many other friends.
I have battled with my half-brother, \n           the full-blooded demon Sesshomaru,
Naraku's wind user incarnation Kagura, \n        and many others have battled against me.
And here beside me is Kagome.
She is Kikyo's reincarnation, and the one who \n   broke my seal.
We argue sometimes, but she's an important \n      friend that I can't live without.
I'm gonna find and defeat my archenemy Naraku, \n    who deceived Kikyo and me 50 years ago!
I can sense a sacred jewel shard nearby.
Looks like you haven't had any luck finding \n     Naraku yet.
Damn it, Koga! What do you want?
I came here to see Kagome.
Don't you even think about making any passes \n    at Kagome!
Damn it! I'm gonna end this once and for all!
I'm going to take his Shikon jewel shards. \n       They're mine now.
Why are you stopping me, Miroku?
You want to chase Kagura, but tonight is the \n     night of the new moon. It's dangerous to go.
I know! But if I don't hurry and go after \n    Kagura, Naraku will get Koga's jewel shards.
Calm down, Inuyasha. Tell me, if you keep \n      chasing after her and she sees you in your
human form, what's going to happen then? \n     Sorry, but I won't let you go after Kagura!
You won't let me?! \n          Damn it! Don't get in my way, Miroku!
Sorry, Miroku! But I'm going after Kagura!
I know that, save your breath!
No matter, I'll put an end to this now!
Kohaku, why don't you help me out here!
All right! I got Koga's jewel shards back!
That's right. Tonight is the night of the new \n   moon.
Kikyo, what are you planning on doing?
He must be defeated before it's too late.
You're going to Naraku by yourself?!
Do you plan to stop me, Inuyasha?
Of course! As if I'd let you go to Naraku on \n    your own!
I must destroy Naraku... \n                   Do not interfere!
Kikyo! I won't let you do this on your own!
To be defeated by you in your human form...
It would seem that I do not have the \n           power to defeat Naraku.
Go, Inuyasha! Naraku should be in the castle, \n    just ahead.
Okay, Kikyo. I promise to destroy Naraku!
I didn't think you'd make it this far.
If you're going to interfere, Inuyasha,
then I'll simply kill you first!
As usual, your listening skills stink!
I guess I'll just have to put an end to you \n     first!
Okay, Naraku! Your miserable life is about \n    to be over!
Do you think you can defeat me so easily?
Naraku! You remember what happened 50 years \n    ago?
I'm gonna end this whole thing, here and now!
You're seriously wrong if you think you're \n     gonna get your way!
This is the final battle! \n                   Let's do it, Kagome!
Isn't it a relief that we've finally destroyed \n  Naraku for good?
When we first met, you said you wanted to use \n   the Shikon jewel to become a full demon.
Is that still what you want to be? \n             A full-fledged demon, I mean?
It sorta would be nice to be even stronger, \n     though.
Personally, I like you just the way you are, \n     Inuyasha.
But if I stay like this, I might not \n           always be able to protect you.
What was that? I couldn't hear you.
It was nothing! Just drop it, okay?!
You don't need a full-fledged demon's power. \n     So you don't need the Shikon Jewel shards.
The Inuyasha I've come to like is the one that \n   does his best, even as a half-demon.
I'm Miroku. I am on a journey to bring down \n    Naraku, in an effort to end the curse of the
Wind Tunnel hand passed down to me from my \n    grandfather's generation. I refuse to stand
by and watch as Naraku uses dirty tricks and  \n   plays on people's weaknesses to carry out his
evil deeds. Sango and I will do whatever it \n     takes to defeat him.
Or at least, that's what I had planned to do.
I'm gonna finish this, once and for all Koga!
What're you yapping on about, Mutt-face?
Kagome and I love each other, so why don't \n      you just butt out!
Yeah--What--I'll prove it! \n                 you wanna fight?
Yeah, bring it on, scrawny wolf!
Shut up, loser dog! Quit your yapping!
Run home with your tail between your legs!
Just shut up and get lost!
Would you look at that. \n                  Those two are at it again...
It's stressful, not being able to find any \n     clues that lead to Naraku.
A little scrap might not hurt, once in a while.
Besides, you have another woman, namely \n       Kikyo!
I won't give Kagome to a womanizer who's just \n   like that monk there!
What?! \n         Don't compare me to that letch Miroku!
Just because I hold my tongue, doesn't mean \n    you can insult me!
That's it! The two of you have crossed \n         the line.
I'm going to fix your attitude, so you won't \n    talk like that anymore.
Listen you two, give up this fighting and be \n    done with it!
He says, while feeling me up!
You perverted Monk! I'm not gonna take this \n    from you anymore!
Now, wait ladies! This Wind Tunnel is a \n  horrible curse that will one day swallow me up.
I don't know how long I'll live, It's a \n       terrible burden for one man to bear, but
before my inevitable demise, it's my duty to \n    find a woman to bear my child.
If you think that's going to excuse your \n         actions,
then you've got another thing coming, \n          Miroku!
C'mon Sango! Let's teach this monk a lesson \n     he'll never forget!
Say no more! Prepare to die, you insolent \n      Monk!
Do you get it now?! Perverted Monk!
Come out of there! We know you're trying to \n     hide!
A family fight, to the death! \n                Get going, Kohaku!
I can smell Naraku on this boy.
Don't get in my way, or I'll kill you people \n     too, right here.
That's not going to happen. Sango, we \n         have to do whatever we can to stall him.
He must've gone to the castle during our fight.
It's all over for you, Naraku!
I'm surprised you made it this far.
I'm going to put an end to my Wind Tunnel \n       curse right here!
Naraku! I'm going to defeat you and take my \n     brother Kohaku back!
I'll show you the destruction I'm capable of!
All right, Sango... This is it!
The Wind Tunnel... it actually \n               disappeared.
I have finally broken my cursed link to Naraku.
So, Sango, now that we've defeated Naraku, \n     what are your plans?
You mean Kohaku. I wonder where he went?
Say Sango, why don't we journey together?
And that way we can look for your brother \n       Kohaku as we travel.
I'm certain we will eventually be able \n        to find him.
Are you sure you're okay with that, \n            Miroku?
Yes, of course I am, Sango.
Once we find Kohaku, we can find a place to \n     live together. For all three of us.
You have my promise that I will take care of \n     you forever, Sango.
Hey! Get your hands off there!
The Tetsusaiga can destroy 100 demons in a \n     single sweep.
Father bequeathed that sword to Inuyasha.
And to me he gave the Tenseiga, which can save \n   100 lives with one stroke.
Father, I can not understand your reasoning.
Why did you leave that inferior half-demon \n     the Tetsusaiga, instead of me?
I came to see what that strange scent was.
Such power and swordsmanship. Just who the \n     heck are you, anyway?!
I can't be bothered with insignificant demons. \n   Get lost!
What did you say to me?
I'm not gonna stand here and be ridiculed by \n    you!
You asked for it! Are you ready to fight?
I'll put you in your place.
And you're the priestess who sealed Inuyasha \n   50 years ago.
Naraku is plotting to take your demonic power.
Naraku must not be allowed to absorb your \n       demonic power.
Ridiculous. An inferior demon such as Naraku \n   would not be able to defeat me.
I didn't expect that you would listen to me.
The sacred arrow you used to seal Inuyasha?
You are mistaken, Priestess, if you think \n      that I am anything like that half-demon.
I will not be defeated by a mere human \n          priestess.
It seems Naraku has another plan up his \n        sleeve!
To tell you the truth, I'm quite surprised \n     you've come here of your own free will.
Sesshomaru, if you want to bring Naraku down, \n    why don't you team up with me?
You are going to betray Naraku?
I can take out Naraku on my own. \n               I have no need of your help.
So Kagura. You're going to betray me?
Well, if that's the case, then my body will \n     absorb you first.
Naraku, you will know regret as you die \n       the miserable, lesser demon that you are.
You're not good enough to be my enemy. \n          What a waste of time.
Don't tell me you defeated Naraku?!
I think it's about time we find out \n            why father entrusted someone like
Wait, Sesshomaru! It's not over yet!
I'm not giving up! There's no way I'm losing!
Are you planning to kill Inuyasha?
There would be no point to that.
Tell Inuyasha this. The next time I see him, \n    if his heart is taken over by demon blood,
I will kill him without fail.
Father... I now see why you entrusted the \n      Tetsusaiga to Inuyasha...
With my adorable good looks and powerful Fox \n    Magic...
I'm the most dependable of Inuyasha's friends!
The great demon Shippo is the real hero here!
Shut up, Shippo! What are you going on about?
This time I am the star!
Hah! You? A real hero? I don't think so!
Face the facts, Shippo. You gotta be strong \n    like me to talk like that!
You're always making me look stupid!
You won't get away with it anymore!
Inuyasha, we'll see which one of us is \n        stronger!
Heh heh, Since I'm the real hero here... \n        I can't lose!
Even the "mighty" Inuyasha doesn't stand a \n      chance against me!
I'm gonna beat everyone that makes a fool \n     of me, so no one forgets how powerful I am!
You're that... Hey, you're that demon raccoon \n  dog! The one that hangs out with Inuyasha!
You're always bragging, just 'cause you're one \n  of the Wolf-Demon clan. I've never liked you
wolves very much. I'm gonna defeat you for \n      myself and for all Fox-Demons.
You're hilarious. You think a little raccoon \n   dog like you can defeat me?
Hey, I told ya! I'm a fox!
I did it; I won! I even beat Sesshomaru! \n       Oh yeah!
I'm the strongest demon in all of the land!
I can handle it all, even without Inuyasha \n      around!
I wonder what Shippo's muttering in his \n        sleep?
Come on, Inuyasha. He's sleeping so peacefully. \n  Just let him be.
